shlokas.sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच | तं तथा कृपयाविष्टम् अश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम् ||1||
shlokas.meaning: Sanjaya said: Seeing Arjuna overwhelmed with compassion, his eyes filled with tears...
shlokas.guidance: Recognize that deep emotional conflict needs to be acknowledged before clarity arises.

shlokas.sanskrit: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते ||2||
shlokas.meaning: Krishna said: Do not yield to this degrading weakness, O Partha; it does not befit you.
shlokas.guidance: Do not let discouragement distract you from your purpose and duty.

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम् ||3||
shlokas.meaning: Arjuna said: From where has this faintheartedness come upon me in this dreadful hour?
shlokas.guidance: Question why fear arises to face it consciously and transcend it.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम् ||4||
shlokas.meaning: Krishna said: I taught this imperishable yoga to Vivasvan, the sun god.
shlokas.guidance: Timeless wisdom is revealed across eras to those prepared to listen and learn.

shlokas.sanskrit: एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः ||5||
shlokas.meaning: Intelligent kings and sages understood this yoga through succession of teachings.
shlokas.guidance: Traditional wisdom handed through lineage strengthens understanding.

shlokas.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञानसहितं योगं असंशयं परमां गतिम् ||6||
shlokas.meaning: That knowledge‑full yoga leads beyond doubt to the supreme state.
shlokas.guidance: Where knowledge and action meet, doubt dissolves and clarity arises.

shlokas.sanskrit: यत ध्यानयुक्तं योगं विन्दन्ति पुरुषो मतिम् ||7||
shlokas.meaning: Those who dwell in meditation find the highest state of mind.
shlokas.guidance: Meditative focus steadies the mind toward truth.

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्यायोऽयोऽयं धर्म्यकर्मकृत् शुभाशुभयोः संवादः ||8||
shlokas.meaning: This chapter is a discourse on righteousness between the doer of duty and its opposite.
shlokas.guidance: Understand the difference between right action and its opposite to walk the path of dharma.

shlokas.sanskrit: नैतदस्ति नात्र शक्यं संशयं कश्चिन्मय्युपपद्यते ||9
shlokas.meaning: There is no possibility of doubt here; it leads to degradation and confusion.
shlokas.guidance: Indecision weakens resolve; clarity strengthens purpose.

shlokas.sanskrit: अयोढ्यते चित्तम् आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थिरः स्याद् ||10||
shlokas.meaning: A mind that is satisfied and steady in the self does not waver.
shlokas.guidance: Inner satisfaction and stability bring steadiness of mind

shlokas.sanskrit: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोति योगिनः किल् ||11||
shlokas.meaning: If the yogi cannot fix the mind in meditation, let him aspire to skillful action.
shlokas.guidance: When meditation is difficult, channel your effort into skillful and mindful action.

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ||12||
shlokas.meaning: Where Krishna, the Supreme Lord of yoga, and Arjuna, the archer, stand assembled...
shlokas.guidance: Union of divine guidance and human effort empowers understanding.

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतः धर्मो यत्र सनातनः ||13||
shlokas.meaning: There, righteousness is born, and eternal principles are upheld.
shlokas.guidance: Where guidance and courage meet, dharma arises.

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्र पार्थः विजयते चाप्यधर्म एव च ||14||
shlokas.meaning: There too, Arjuna is victorious and unrighteousness is defeated.
shlokas.guidance: Align your actions with righteousness, and victory follows.

shlokas.sanskrit: अथवा धर्मयुद्धे विजयः संन्यस्तकर्मणि ||15||
shlokas.meaning: Or in righteous war, victory arises through surrendered action.
shlokas.guidance: Surrendering outcomes to duty brings clarity of purpose.

shlokas.sanskrit: दुरात्मानः कुतर्का वैरिणः पापकारणाः ||16||
shlokas.meaning: Those of wicked intellect, full of fault‑finding and sin, are enemies of virtue.
shlokas.guidance: Discern intention; harmful motives arise from delusion and bias.

shlokas.sanskrit: कामात्मानः स्वर्गपार्थाः कामरागप्रवर्जिताः ||17||
shlokas.meaning: Those desiring heaven are driven by pleasure and attachment.
shlokas.guidance: Desires bind the mind; freedom comes from detachment.

shlokas.sanskrit: दैवासूरसमुद्भवा सर्वैताः पुण्यनैषठिकाः ||18||
shlokas.meaning: Those born of divine or demonic impulses exist; both paths unfold consequences.
shlokas.guidance: Actions rooted in divine values bear wholesome fruit; those from ignorance bear harm.

shlokas.sanskrit: अन्तवन्त इमे देवा दैवे प्रयन्ति धर्मयुताः ||19||
shlokas.meaning: The gods, aligned with dharma, reach the supreme goal.
shlokas.guidance: Align with righteous principles to realize higher purpose.

shlokas.sanskrit: यतन्तोऽपि संयम्येन्द्रियग्रामं गच्छन्त्यपि चैव ||20||
shlokas.meaning: Even those who restrain their senses, yet remain attached, go to mixed outcomes.
shlokas.guidance: External restraint without inner clarity leads to partial progress.

shlokas.sanskrit: नैवेह कर्म लभ्यते न सुखं संशयात्मना ||21||
shlokas.meaning: Neither here nor beyond is fulfillment attained by the doubting mind.
shlokas.guidance: Firm conviction fuels meaningful progress.

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त्विंद्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन ||22||
shlokas.meaning: One who controls the senses with the mind, O Arjuna...
shlokas.guidance: Rule your senses with mind to realize lasting steadiness.

shlokas.sanskrit: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचि न्न्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः ||23||
shlokas.meaning: The soul is neither born nor does it ever die; it is eternal, unchanging, and beyond birth and death.
shlokas.guidance: Understand the eternal nature of the self to overcome fear of loss and death.

shlokas.sanskrit: अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे ||24||
shlokas.meaning: It is unborn, eternal, ancient, and does not die when the body dies.
shlokas.guidance: Detach from the impermanent body and realize the true self.

shlokas.sanskrit: वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यमवाध्यं सर्वगतं स्थितम् ||25||
shlokas.meaning: It is indestructible, eternal, all-pervading, and unchangeable.
shlokas.guidance: Realizing this eternal truth brings inner peace and courage.

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य नाहं नास्याहं न तस्य सन्निधिं पश्यामि ||26||
shlokas.meaning: When the soul is realized as imperishable, wise people do not grieve over the body.
shlokas.guidance: Grief arises from ignorance of the eternal self.

shlokas.sanskrit: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च ||27||
shlokas.meaning: For the one born, death is certain; for the one dead, birth is certain. Therefore, you should not lament over the inevitable.
shlokas.guidance: Accept life’s natural cycles with equanimity.

shlokas.sanskrit: न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः ||28||
shlokas.meaning: You, I, and these kings of men never cease to exist eternally; the soul transcends all forms.
shlokas.guidance: Detach from identification with temporary roles and bodies.

shlokas.sanskrit: न हि शरीराणि न मे हि जन्मान्यतीतानि च ||29||
shlokas.meaning: Bodies are transient; the soul remains unchanged through all past and future births.
shlokas.guidance: Do not confuse the body with the soul; the self is eternal.

shlokas.sanskrit: यथैवं शरीरं कौन्तेय नित्यं युक्तं कर्मणि सदा ||30||
shlokas.meaning: Just as the soul pervades all bodies, it is wise to act with a sense of duty.
shlokas.guidance: Focus on duty while understanding the eternal nature of the soul.

shlokas.sanskrit: शरीरं सर्वमिदं प्राणिनां नित्यं न हि क्षणिकम् ||31||
shlokas.meaning: All bodies are perishable; the soul is constant and enduring.
shlokas.guidance: Do not fear bodily harm; focus on inner duty and consciousness.

shlokas.sanskrit: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन ||32||
shlokas.meaning: You have a right to perform your duty, but not to the fruits of action.
shlokas.guidance: Focus on action, not on the outcome.

shlokas.sanskrit: मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ||33||
shlokas.meaning: Do not let the desire for results be your motivation, and do not be attached to inaction.
shlokas.guidance: Perform duties selflessly without attachment to results.

shlokas.sanskrit: संगं त्यक्त्वा हरिष्यसि भोगैश्वर्यसुखैः सह ||34||
shlokas.meaning: By renouncing attachment, you achieve peace and liberation.
shlokas.guidance: Detachment from desires brings true strength and serenity.

shlokas.sanskrit: सुखदुःखसहभूः सः योगी समाहितात्मा ||35||
shlokas.meaning: A yogi remains balanced in pleasure and pain, steady of mind.
shlokas.guidance: Equanimity in all conditions is the hallmark of wisdom.

shlokas.sanskrit: सदा हि योगी बलवान् पुरुषार्थसमन्वितः ||36||
shlokas.meaning: A yogi is always strong and focused on the right effort.
shlokas.guidance: Strength arises from disciplined action aligned with dharma.

shlokas.sanskrit: यथोक्तं गुरुं श्रोष्यसि विज्ञानसमन्वितः ||37||
shlokas.meaning: Hear and follow the guidance of a teacher imbued with knowledge.
shlokas.guidance: Seek wisdom from those who embody clarity and virtue.

shlokas.sanskrit: समत्वं योग उच्यते परं संतोषसमन्वितम् ||38||
shlokas.meaning: Yoga is equanimity, the state of being satisfied and balanced.
shlokas.guidance: Balance and contentment are the essence of yoga.

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः ||39||
shlokas.meaning: One who dedicates actions to Brahman without attachment attains liberation.
shlokas.guidance: Selfless action aligned with higher purpose leads to freedom.

shlokas.sanskrit: नैव तत् कृत्यं न कर्मफलम् अङ्गीकुर्याद् ||40||
shlokas.meaning: Action should not be for selfish gain; detachment brings clarity.
shlokas.guidance: Avoid selfish motives; act for the sake of dharma.

shlokas.sanskrit: यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहः पुरुषं प्रेम्यपश्यति ||41||
shlokas.meaning: One who sees all beings with equal vision, unattached, attains yoga.
shlokas.guidance: Impartiality and non-attachment lead to true realization.

shlokas.sanskrit: समत्वं योग उच्यते, सदा शांतः पुरुषः ||42||
shlokas.meaning: Equanimity is yoga; a person remains calm in all circumstances.
shlokas.guidance: Peaceful composure is the hallmark of spiritual maturity.

shlokas.sanskrit: सत्त्वमयः शरीरः, ज्ञानं स्थिरचित्तम् ||43||
shlokas.meaning: A body of purity and a mind grounded in wisdom is the essence of a yogi.
shlokas.guidance: Purity of body and clarity of mind support spiritual progress.

shlokas.sanskrit: कर्मण्येवाधिकारः ते, मा फलेषु कदाचन ||44||
shlokas.meaning: Your right is to action alone, never to its fruits.
shlokas.guidance: Act with duty, not with attachment to outcomes.

shlokas.sanskrit: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय ||45||
shlokas.meaning: Be steadfast in yoga, perform your duties, abandoning attachment, O Dhananjaya.
shlokas.guidance: Perform duty with mindfulness and detachment.

shlokas.sanskrit: सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा समत्वं योगोऽयं परं पुरुषोत्तम ||46||
shlokas.meaning: By abandoning attachment and maintaining equanimity, one attains the supreme yoga.
shlokas.guidance: Equanimity and detachment together constitute supreme yoga.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच ||47||
shlokas.meaning: The Lord speaks, guiding Arjuna toward steadfast action.
shlokas.guidance: Seek guidance from wisdom to navigate moral dilemmas.

shlokas.sanskrit: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि, सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय ||48||
shlokas.meaning: Establish yourself in yoga, perform your duty, abandoning attachment, O Dhananjaya.
shlokas.guidance: Perform all actions with a sense of duty and without attachment.

shlokas.sanskrit: सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ||49||
shlokas.meaning: Equanimity in success and failure is called yoga.
shlokas.guidance: Treat victory and defeat with equal composure.

shlokas.sanskrit: बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते ||50||
shlokas.meaning: A person endowed with wisdom abandons both good and evil actions here.
shlokas.guidance: Act with detachment, leaving behind results of both merits and faults.

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ||51||
shlokas.meaning: Wherever there is Krishna, the master of yoga, and wherever there is Arjuna, the supreme archer, there also will surely be glory, victory, prosperity, and sound morality.
shlokas.guidance: Associating with wisdom and skill ensures success and righteousness.

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च ||52||
shlokas.meaning: Therefore, at all times, remember Me and fight.
shlokas.guidance: Stay mindful of higher guidance while performing your duties.

shlokas.sanskrit: शरीरवस्मिन्स्थितो हि मनः कर्मणि निच्छलः ||53||
shlokas.meaning: The mind situated in the body performs duties without attachment.
shlokas.guidance: Detach the self from the body’s identification while acting.

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा सर्वगतं ज्ञानं योगयुक्तो विशिष्यते ||54||
shlokas.meaning: One endowed with knowledge and yoga sees the self in all beings and transcends dualities.
shlokas.guidance: Awareness of oneness reduces conflict and brings clarity.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माणि मनसः संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा ||55||
shlokas.meaning: Renouncing all actions in the mind, dedicating them to the self, one attains peace.
shlokas.guidance: Mental renunciation and dedication of actions lead to spiritual calm.

shlokas.sanskrit: यदा सर्वे संकर्षे युक्ता दृष्टा बुद्धिस्थिता ||56||
shlokas.meaning: When all beings are seen equally, and the intellect is steady, one is said to be established in yoga.
shlokas.guidance: Equanimity in perception leads to mastery over the mind.

shlokas.sanskrit: मुक्तः सः सर्वकर्मेभ्यः योगयुक्तो विशिष्यते ||57||
shlokas.meaning: Freed from all attachments, one established in yoga surpasses others.
shlokas.guidance: Freedom from attachment grants superior spiritual strength.

shlokas.sanskrit: संगं त्यक्त्वा सर्वेषु कर्मसु सिद्धिं लभते परम् ||58||
shlokas.meaning: Abandoning attachment in all actions, one attains the highest perfection.
shlokas.guidance: Detachment in every act leads to ultimate fulfillment.

shlokas.sanskrit: बुद्धियोगयुक्तः कर्म करोति न फलेषु च न संकोचः ||59||
shlokas.meaning: A person performing duties with intellect and yoga is not shaken by success or failure.
shlokas.guidance: Perform duties with mindfulness, remaining unperturbed by outcomes.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माणि सङ्गमुक्ता यः पश्यति सः योगिनः ||60||
shlokas.meaning: One who sees all actions free from attachment is a true yogi.
shlokas.guidance: Detachment in action defines spiritual mastery.

shlokas.sanskrit: अकर्मण्येव कर्म यः पश्येत्स विद्धि स्थितः समः ||61||
shlokas.meaning: One who sees that inaction is impossible and acts without attachment is truly steady.
shlokas.guidance: Understand that even non-action is a form of action; act wisely.

shlokas.sanskrit: ध्यानयोगयुक्तः पुरुषः सुखमात्मा सुखमाप्नुयात् ||62||
shlokas.meaning: A person established in meditation attains happiness of self, independent of external conditions.
shlokas.guidance: Inner contentment comes from mental discipline and meditation.

shlokas.sanskrit: यथोक्तं कर्मणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा विशिष्यते सः ||63||
shlokas.meaning: By abandoning attachment to all acts, one excels among yogis.
shlokas.guidance: Detachment leads to distinction and mastery in yoga.

shlokas.sanskrit: नासक्तः सुख-दुःखेषु समः समदु:ख-सुखः ||64||
shlokas.meaning: One unattached remains balanced in pleasure and pain, calm in both sorrow and happiness.
shlokas.guidance: Equanimity in all circumstances is the hallmark of wisdom.

shlokas.sanskrit: सुखदुःखे समौचित्यं योगी युञ्जीत सततम् ||65||
shlokas.meaning: A yogi consistently applies equal-mindedness in pleasure and pain.
shlokas.guidance: Steady balance in all situations strengthens spiritual maturity.

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणि स्थितं मनः कुर्वन्नयं निःश्रेयसिकम् ||66||
shlokas.meaning: One whose mind is established in Brahman acts for ultimate welfare, transcending personal desire.
shlokas.guidance: Focus on the supreme good rather than personal gain.

shlokas.sanskrit: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते ||67||
shlokas.meaning: Nothing in this world is as purifying as knowledge.
shlokas.guidance: Seek wisdom, for knowledge elevates and purifies.

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्यास्यते चित्तं योगिनीं सम्यग् ज्ञानी स्थिरः ||68||
shlokas.meaning: A yogi with steady mind remains devoted to knowledge and wisdom.
shlokas.guidance: Focus and steadiness in knowledge cultivate inner peace.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं योगी समस्मितः ||69||
shlokas.meaning: A yogi sees the self in all beings and all beings in the self.
shlokas.guidance: Unity with all life fosters compassion and detachment.

shlokas.sanskrit: नित्यं संयम्येन्द्रियाणि कर्मयोगसिद्धः पुरुषः ||70||
shlokas.meaning: One who constantly controls the senses attains perfection through karma yoga.
shlokas.guidance: Self-discipline leads to mastery and inner fulfillment.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माणि मयि सन्न्यस्य युञ्जीत सततम् ||71||
shlokas.meaning: Constantly dedicating all actions to Me, one attains supreme yoga.
shlokas.guidance: Selfless devotion in every act leads to ultimate realization.

shlokas.sanskrit: योगी सर्वत्र समः सन् मुक्तः सर्वभयात् ||72||
shlokas.meaning: A yogi, established in equanimity, is free from all fear and attains supreme peace.
shlokas.guidance: Equanimity and detachment lead to fearlessness and liberation.
